add_comment.label: Add Comment or Work Note
add_comment.description: Append a customer-visible comment or an internal work note to a record (incident, request, problem, change, etc.)

record.label: Record
record.description: Select a record from the table

manual_sys_id.label: Or Enter Sys ID Manually
manual_sys_id.description: Enter the sys_id directly if not found in dropdown

comment_type.label: Type
comment_type.description: Customer-visible comment or internal work note

comment.label: Comment
comment.description: The text to append to the record

resolve_incident.label: Resolve or Close Incident
resolve_incident.description: Move an incident to Resolved or Closed with a close code and resolution notes

incident_sys_id.label: Incident sys_id
incident_sys_id.description: sys_id of the incident to resolve or close

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Resolved keeps the record open for closure later; Closed finalizes it.

close_notes.label: Resolution Notes
close_notes.description: Resolution notes shown to the caller

resolved_by.label: Resolved By (User sys_id)
resolved_by.description: Optional sys_id of the user who resolved the incident. Defaults to the authenticated user.

delete_attachment.label: Delete Attachment
delete_attachment.description: Delete an attachment by its sys_id

attachment_sys_id.label: Attachment Sys ID
attachment_sys_id.description: The sys_id of the attachment to delete (use Find File to look it up)

get_catalog_item.label: Get Catalog Item
get_catalog_item.description: Retrieve full details of a catalog item including its variable definitions. Use this before "Submit Catalog Request" to discover the variables expected by the item.

item_sys_id.label: Catalog Item
item_sys_id.description: Select a catalog item to order

manual_item_sys_id.label: Or Enter Catalog Item Sys ID Manually
manual_item_sys_id.description: Provide the catalog item sys_id directly if it is not in the dropdown

submit_catalog_item.label: Submit Catalog Request
submit_catalog_item.description: Order a catalog item. Submits a service catalog request and returns the resulting request number.

item_sys_id.label: Catalog Item
item_sys_id.description: Select a catalog item to order

manual_item_sys_id.label: Or Enter Catalog Item Sys ID Manually
manual_item_sys_id.description: Provide the catalog item sys_id directly if it is not in the dropdown

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: How many of this item to order

requested_for.label: Requested For (User Sys ID)
requested_for.description: sys_id of the user the request is for. Defaults to the authenticated user.

variables.label: Variables
variables.description: Catalog item variables as a JSON object (variable_name → value)

search_knowledge_articles.label: Search Knowledge Articles
search_knowledge_articles.description: Search published knowledge base articles using free text. Requires the Knowledge API plugin to be active.

kb.label: Knowledge Base sys_id
kb.description: Optional. Limit search to a specific knowledge base.

language.label: Language
language.description: Optional ISO language code (e.g., en, de, fr)

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1-100)

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of articles to skip for pagination

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Optional list of article field names to include in the response

get_knowledge_article.label: Get Knowledge Article
get_knowledge_article.description: Retrieve the full content of a knowledge article by sys_id

article_sys_id.label: Article Sys ID
article_sys_id.description: sys_id of the article. Use "Search Knowledge Articles" first if you only have a KB number.

update_view.label: Increment View Count
update_view.description: Whether to increment the article view counter when fetching

send_email.label: Send Email
send_email.description: Send an email through your ServiceNow instance using the Email API. Requires the email outbound capability to be configured.

to.label: To
to.description: One or more recipient email addresses

body.label: Body
body.description: Email body. HTML is supported by ServiceNow.

from.label: From
from.description: Optional sender address. Defaults to the instance email-from setting.

send_email.afterResponse: return response && response.result !== undefined && response.result !== null ? response.result : response;

count_records.label: Count Records
count_records.description: Return the number of records in a table that match an optional encoded query (uses the Aggregate API)

query.label: Query
query.description: Optional encoded query to filter records (e.g., active=true^state=1)

count_records.afterResponse:
var raw = response && response.result && response.result.stats && response.result.stats.count != null ? response.result.stats.count : 0;
return { table: inputs.table, query: inputs.query || null, count: typeof raw === 'number' ? raw : (parseInt(String(raw), 10) || 0) };

new_comment.label: New Comment or Work Note
new_comment.description: Triggers when a new comment or work note is added to a record in the selected table

record_sys_id.label: Record Sys ID Filter (optional)
record_sys_id.description: If set, only fire for comments on this specific record sys_id
